name: claude-code-skills
description: A personal, open-source collection of Claude Code plugins and skills for real-world software engineering.

plugins.name: dev-flow
plugins.description: Drive one large, multi-phase or multi-PR change end to end — plan, execute task-by-task with a live ledger, ship per PR, and resume cleanly across sessions. Works in any repo that has a .claude/dev-flow-context.md.
